sayIt.cover: Read the three facts out loud, slowly: when it started, when it renews, what it renews at. Then: 'Since we're on the call, I can do one thing for you.' Click.
sayIt.offer: Name it, read the four lines. Then click: bonus one, bonus two, bonus three, one at a time, a sentence each. Last click: the price. Stop talking.
sayIt.pay: 'I have your card on file. Do I have your permission to run it?' Then silence. Tap Lock it in and watch it go green. No card: the link is on the slide.
sayIt.gameplan: 'Totally fine. Here's exactly how to win with it this week.' Walk the three cards, then tap Send the game plan while they watch. (Paid somewhere the deck can't see? Press G.)
sayIt.celebrate: 'Account's live, email's coming, purple chat for anything. Welcome in.' Tap send the email while they watch.
sayIt.review: 'One last thing, it would mean the world to me. How was today? Scan that with your phone, 30 seconds.' Stay on the slide while they do it.
